summary.text: Hannah Cole is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 86, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican incumbent David Hardin.
A health care professional, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities include protecting rural land and water, improving access to rural health care, and funding public schools.

paragraphs.text: Hannah Cole graduated from Tahlequah High School, completed education at the Indian Capital Technology Center in 2011, and lists health care professional as her profession.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born at Hastings hospital and raised in Northeast Oklahoma on a small hobby farm, where her father was a carpenter and her mother was a nurse.
She said she has since moved back to her late father's land.
In the survey, Cole named protecting rural land, water and working families, improving practical access to care, and putting community needs over party pressure as her key messages.

She said she would fight to fully fund rural public schools and oppose diverting taxpayer dollars from public education to private systems, and that as a nurse she supports protecting and expanding Medicaid.
